item.title: 🔴 Microsoft October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,411 flaws, 3 zero-days
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.
Today is Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday, with security updates addressing a record-breaking 1,411 flaws, including one actively exploited and two publicly disclosed zero-day vulnerabilities. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: <1h

item.title: 🔴 Ivanti Zero-Day Chain Gave Attackers Root Access to Fully Patched VPN
item.description:
Why this matters: Remote-code-execution risk — assess exposure and patch or mitigate quickly.

CVE-2026-104935 affects Ivanti Connect Secure and it can be exploited for unauthenticated remote code execution with elevated privileges. 

The post Ivanti Zero-Day Chain Gave Attackers Root Access to Fully Patched VPN appeared first on SecurityWeek.



Source: SecurityWeek  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 1h

item.title: 🔴 Attackers Exploit CVSS 10.0 Bricksforge WordPress Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
item.description:
Why this matters: Remote-code-execution risk — assess exposure and patch or mitigate quickly.
A maximum-severity security flaw impacting the Bricksforge plugin for WordPress has come under active exploitation in the wild, according to Patchstack. The critical vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-85097 (CVSS score: 10.0), which allows unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute arbitrary PHP code on vulnerable WordPress websites, resulting in remote code execution (RCE).
